name: search-field
description: Search field that shows a clear button as soon as you type and submits on ImeAction.Search.
avoidWhen: Do not use for general text; use text-field. Do not put Cancel on the field; that is the screen.

ux.behaviour: A decorative magnifier and a Search placeholder; no label
ux.why: You know it is search before you tap it

ux.behaviour: A clear button appears the moment there is text; tapping it empties the field and keeps focus
ux.why: Starting a new search should not mean holding backspace

ux.behaviour: ImeAction.Search calls onSearch with the current value
ux.why: The key that says Search should search

aiHints: Wire onSearch; ImeAction.Search does nothing unless you do
Do not pass a label; the placeholder is the name
